box: short-stick (/game/short-stick/) — refresh mid-sequence returns cleanly to setup (no silent resume, no silent discard), and a pre-existing live เซียมซี checkpoint in the shared slot survives untouched
method: scripts/driver.mjs, one CDP tab (session persists across nav() calls in the same tab — required, sessionStorage is per-tab/per-origin), real headless Chrome (--headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --remote-debugging-port=9222), against a real build (npm run build + npx serve dist/ -l 4321). Wiped storage on-origin and verified empty. Seeded a LIVE เซียมซี checkpoint through the real UI (played /game/siamsi/, not written directly): start-numbered with 3 players, ss-start (idle->turn), ss-draw (turn 1), ss-pass, ss-draw (turn 2) — leaving phase 'drawn', 2 results banked, 1 card left, holder=1 (mid-round, matching docs/verification/evidence/20's technique). Captured sessionStorage['watduang:session']. Crossed to /game/short-stick/ in the SAME tab, confirmed no popup fires merely from a foreign game's checkpoint sitting in the slot. Started a 10-player short-stick round (start-numbered), clicked sticks one at a time until landing on a genuine mid-sequence passing screen (one stick drawn, short stick not yet surfaced) -- when the short stick surfaced before any passing screen, rerolled via 'เล่นอีกรอบ' (never touches session/checkpoint) and tried again. Re-captured sessionStorage['watduang:session'] immediately before refresh. Refreshed (session.nav to the same URL, same tab). Captured post-refresh DOM state and sessionStorage['watduang:session'] again. Then pressed start-numbered a second time post-refresh to confirm short-stick neither silently resumes its own mid-sequence state nor silently discards the foreign checkpoint.
